correctness.rationale: For each blue rook vertex the white-neighbor count is d_H(row)+d_H(column); this exactly identifies permissible leaf deletions with opposite-side isolates. Cycle persistence proves necessity and sequential peeling proves sufficiency. Sharp spanning-tree extremizers and the bipartite Prufer word surjection exclusion prove the count. Fixed-isolate tree basis exchanges prove connectivity for thick grids, while an explicit bijection to K_1 join L(K_{t,t}-M_t) proves the two thin components. An independently coded exhaustive verifier checks all subsets for ten grids and the thin bijections up to t=12.
